title: Cities: Skylines | Franklin, Episode 9: Organized Labor
premise: Donoteat01 argues that collective, explicitly anti-racist labor organization wins material gains and should protect workers rather than merely preserve jobs within capitalism. Roman plebeians, Luddites and the 1835 Philadelphia-inspired general strike frame a modern union taxonomy interrupted by a deliberately fabricated Jimmy Hoffa rescue adventure.
coverage: Complete timestamped ASR read; all 61 original contact sheets (727 sampled frames) plus ten helper-registered supplemental sheets/frames inspected: 71 indexed sheets and 737 frames total. Original sampling is first available image per 5-second bin plus scene score >0.30 at 480px. Supplemental inserts at 737.2, 766.2, 836.8, 1406.5, 1692, 2166.5, 2371.3, 2573.2, 2630.7 and 2634.3 seconds recover brief overlays found by lower-threshold QA. Five native stills inspected at 122.5, 1285, 1990, 2635, 2700 seconds. Sparse sampling is not continuous viewing; brief inserts and motion between samples can be missed. Full speech is renderer-derived from transcript word times, not authored excerpts. No independent source-audio listening: music identifications use metadata with approximate section association; empty sound arrays mean unannotated, not silence. Evidence links and unresolved readings are in the supporting story sheet.
